title: dualizable object
why_consulted: vol1 ch1 §4.1 可对偶性的 nLab 对照，正文 4.1.1–4.1.7 与 §6.3 的稳定范畴对偶
definition_zh: 在幺半 (∞,1)-范畴 A 中，对象 a 称为右可对偶的，若存在对象 a^{∨,R}（a 的右对偶）以及 1-态射 a ⊗ a^{∨,R} → 1_A（余单位）与 1_A → a^{∨,R} ⊗ a（单位），使得两条三角复合分别同构于恒等态射 id_a 与 id_{a^{∨,R}}；左可对偶对偶地定义。等价的说法是：把 A 看成只有一个对象的 (∞,2)-范畴时，a 与 a^{∨,R} 互为伴随的 1-态射。对称幺半情形下左右两种概念一致，统称可对偶（dualizable）。
key_points: 与伴随的等价：DAG §4.1.3 明确指出，右/左对偶的框架就是 (∞,2)-范畴中 1-态射的伴随；幺半 (∞,1)-范畴的数据等价于只有一个对象的 (∞,2)-范畴的数据，单位/余单位即伴随的单位/余单位。
唯一性：给定 a 的右对偶，对偶数据 (a^{∨,R}, a ⊗ a^{∨,R} → 1_A) 与 (a^{∨,R}, 1_A → a^{∨,R} ⊗ a) 各自被唯一确定，只要再固定一条三角恒等式的道路（DAG 4.1.2 (4.3)(4.4)）；因此可以谈论「a 的右对偶」这个对象。
对偶化函子：A^{right-dualizable} 与 A^{left-dualizable} 分别是右、左可对偶对象张成的全子范畴，对偶化给出幺半 (∞,1)-范畴的等价 (A^{right-dualizable})^{op} ≃ (A^{left-dualizable})^{rev-mult}（DAG 4.1.4）；对称幺半时三者合一。
稳定情形（DAG §6.3）：1-Cat^{St,cocmpl}_{cont} 在 Lurie 张量积下是幺半的，其可对偶对象称为可对偶余完备稳定范畴；对偶数据由 ε: C ⊗ D → Sptr 与 μ: Sptr → D ⊗ C 给出，且 Funct_{ex,cont}(C, D) ≃ C^{∨} ⊗ D。
idea_original: A (left/right) dual to an object in a monoidal category 𝒞\mathcal{C} is a left/right adjoint to the object regarded as a morphism in the delooping 2-category B𝒞\mathbf{B}\mathcal{C}. If a dual exists, the object is called dualizable. Being dualizable may often be thought of as a category-theoretic notion of finiteness [Pareigis 1976 p. 113] for objects in a monoidal category. For instance: a vector space is dualizable in Vect with its standard tensor product of vector spaces precisely if it is a finite-dimensional vector space (cf. Exp. ), a spectrum is dualizable in the stable homotopy category with its smash product precisely if it is a finite spectrum. A more precise intuition is that an object is dualizable if its “size” is no larger than the “additivity” of the monoidal category. For instance, since Vect and the stable homotopy category are finitely additive, but not infinitely so, dualizability there is indeed a notion of plain finiteness, as is the case for many monoidal categories in which one considers dualizability.
